Hi Bethany — great to hear the team is up for a hands-on run. We have a short prep checklist and a starter payload template that covers the things you asked for. I attached the redaction checklist (redaction_checklist_v1.xlsx) and a zipped sample payload (acme_payload_sample.zip) that matches our batch schema.

High level guidance:
- File format: NDJSON inside a zip, 1–5k tokens per item recommended for routing tests.
- Redaction: Remove email addresses, replace customer_id with CID-XXXX, and redact internal URLs. See the attached checklist for fields to redact/transform.
- Naming: {company}_onramp_YYYYMMDD_v1.zip (helps tracking across rollouts).
- Upload: Use the Drive link I shared below; set editor access for engineers@acme-ai.com so they can drop test files.

Availability: We can do 90m or 2h slots. Current windows (PT):
- Tue 7/28 10:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Thu 7/30 14:00–16:00 (preferred for load tests — quieter infra window)

Prep steps for Acme before the session:
1) Upload redacted sample zip to the Drive link and confirm file names.
2) Provide 10–20 core test prompts and 40–100 conversational examples for routing evaluation.
3) Flag any sensitive columns that need additional masking.

Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=example123

I'll loop in Karthik and Marissa to call out routing/load test specifics and observability expectations.

— Soojin Lee

Thanks Soojin — a couple of operational notes from my side:

- Routing/variants: If you expect mixed latency requirements across prompts, please tag each example with an expected SLA label (low/medium/high). We can map those to model variants during the session.
- Load tests: For the load phase we'll need a sustained stream of 60–120 QPS for a 10min window (if you want a stress test) or a stepped ramp for characterization. Indicate which you'd prefer in a short note when you upload.
- Eval sets: Please include a small labeled eval set (25–50 items) with expected outputs for regression checks.

Also confirming teams: Engs on engineers@acme-ai.com for payload upload; Bethany if there are PMs or CS folks you want on the call add them to the Drive folder.

One ask for Acme: Can you provide a single canonical prompt library (text files) that we can use to run routing experiments? That helps keep results reproducible.
